prototypeprinciples.name: A Thread Through Night / guided personal light journey
prototypeprinciples.visitor_action: Follow a luminous thread through successive night landscapes and read short reflections on how Victor thinks and works, with a chapter menu that skips directly to any information.
prototypeprinciples.environment_camera: Low cinematic camera moves along an original light path over open water, broken basalt terrain and a final quiet architectural threshold. Guided scroll, not free exploration; every stage has a stable stop.
prototypeprinciples.palette_system: Begin ochre-black, transition to cyan moonlight, then mint-white threshold. Deliberate distinct chapter fields; preserve genuine environmental material instead of recoloring one black canvas.
prototypeprinciples.type_system: Sparse tiny scenic markers plus dramatically large multiline editorial text between scenes. Content body 16–18px with comfortable contrast; original concise first-person prose rather than source slogans.
prototypeprinciples.first_view: A luminous original strand across reflective terrain and one short personal introductory sentence; Victor’s identity/role and direct chapter menu visible without traversing entire journey.
prototypeprinciples.reading_system: Alternate immersive scene with full-canvas typographic movement: About as large plain text on black; Approach as paced paragraphs keyed to steps, not three boxed pillars; Curiosity as short marginal notes accompanying a moonlit landscape; Contact at an open bright threshold with truthful availability and LinkedIn. Reading stops are real HTML, not painted tiny WebGL text.
prototypeprinciples.signature_interaction: Scroll advances a light strand and camera to authored anchors, pauses for reading, then resumes; instant chapter navigation and reduced-motion stills preserve identical content. Optional click can illuminate a local strand but never gate access.
prototypeprinciples.mobile_plan: Use separately composed portrait scenes, not cropped wide render; shorter camera distance and fewer particles; document-scroll text between scene posters, sticky chapter control; static curated stills when WebGL unsupported. No massive tiny overlay paragraphs.
prototypeprinciples.feasible_original_assets: Procedural original rugged terrain mesh with layered relief/bump, designed shorelines, fog depth, reflective water and spline light strands; use original architectural forms rather than copying source statues/pyramids. Pre-render detailed locally authored scenes for mobile/fallback. Do not ship archived footage/images.
prototypeprinciples.provenance: Borrow low-camera scale, light-path continuity, chapter color changes and full-page typographic breathing. No source sculpture, terrain/model, slogans, agency claims, culture-project portfolio or proprietary shaders.
prototypeprinciples.avoid_siblings: Not underwater/vertical depth architecture of old BelowSurface, botanical Garden, alien expedition, OS, lit house, or cinematic flat filmstrip. Signature is open night terrain traversed by a continuous luminous thread with distinct reading pauses.

finding.research_scope: Research only; pinned reference; no UI build; no accepted ten/production changes.
